snippet.title: Danganronpa 2x2 – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Danganronpa 2x2 is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch on January 14, 2027!

The game will feature the original setting and characters with a brand-new story to explore. A single incident will lead you to a new set of victims, culprits, and tricks.

#NintendoDirect #Danganronpa2x2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
